mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, content, status, is_pinned, create_time, update_time FROM memo WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, status ASC, update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memo(user_id, content, status, is_pinned, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{memo.userId}, #{memo.content}, #{memo.status}, #{memo.isPinned}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM memo WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
